= Links and Images

The link macro takes its text from the brackets: see
link:https://example.com/docs[the documentation] for more.

With empty brackets the target speaks for itself:
link:https://example.com[].

A bare URL is linked where it stands, and the period ending this sentence is
not part of it: https://example.com/a/b.

Punctuation inside a URL survives, since more of the URL follows it, as in
https://sub.example.com/a.html and https://example.com/a_b_c.

An inline image:icon.png[icon] sits in the run of text.

A block image stands on its own line:

image::photo.jpg[A scenic photo]

Alt text is optional, though the attribute is always written:

image::diagram.svg[]
